meta.name: The Red Land
meta.description:
Two tyrant brothers Amarpal Singh and Samarpal Singh who have ruled the land on their own terms for more than three decades, cross path with a young boy Ajit Yadav who happens to be the son...

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: The Land Mafia
videos.overview: Story of two brothers where everyone respects them out of fear , where even police hesitates to bother them. A land ruled by Amarpal Singh and Samarpal Singh.

videos.title: The Candidate
videos.overview: Vikram wants to run for college election and being the son of Amarpal Singh everyone in college fears him, no other student dares to run for election opposite him, but Shiva decide to choose a candidate who will be running against Vikram.

videos.title: Party Union
videos.overview: Threatened by Vikram, candidate selected by Shiva backs out from the election and an unknown stranger registers his name as candidate for the election. Shiva and the unknown stranger team up in order to beat Vikram Singh.

videos.title: The Clash
videos.overview: After a fail attempt to threaten Ajit, Vikram calls his cousin brother Babloo for help. Finally these friends from past meet again as enemies.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Samarpal Singh visit Vikram's college where he comes to know about the real identity of Ajit who is running against his nephew for election.

videos.title: Son Of The Gun
videos.overview: After all the stress from election rally while on their way Ajit and Shiva rescue a girl from the gangsters where Ajit decide to take her to his father's house.

videos.title: Love and War
videos.overview: After election dates getting postponed Ajit leave for his home and decides to spend some time there with his family and Rani. On the other hand Babloo tries manipulate Shiva against Ajit.

videos.title: The Chaos
videos.overview: As bitter memories from past reveal, Amarpal Singh finally demands for power and decides to get Samarpal Singh out of his way. Will this greed for power lead to chaos.
